role: research-director (Opus), brief of the main session
decision: revise: splice allowed only after the conditions below; the verdict is a resampling sensitivity, not a finding about the vehicle
scientific_meaning: Under the frozen rule the verdict 'depends on the resampling unit' is correct: at 3-10 km the W and WS intervals exclude zero while the day-clustered interval includes it. The day-clustered reading stays primary; the Warm-vs-Shoulder contrast is not established.
conditions: (a) report the new 3-10 km point estimate, its shift against the previous -2.49 [-5.65, 1.21] and endpointWithinMcErrorOfZero with the MC SD for every procedure; if the point is outside the previous CI a blind audit is required
(b) check the thermal_regime of the 15 new drives and the per-cohort drive, day and week counts; say plainly if the flip comes from cohort composition rather than dependence
(c) blind audit reproduces the W/WS endpoints, week counts and drop counts with zero mismatches
(d) dashboard sentence and table bind to payload keys, no typed literals
a CHANGELOG entry records this ruling; no Andrii approval exists and none is implied
wording: Depends on the resampling unit (block sensitivity across neighbouring dates; uncertainty analysis, not a change of the point estimate): at 3-10 km the day-clustered interval includes zero; the week-block intervals (W, WS) exclude it. Narrower block intervals are not stronger evidence. Warm-vs-Shoulder contrast not established. Thermal cohorts (ambient threshold) are confounded with season, date and drift.
reject 'at the edge of zero' (add to language_gate RULES with the ledger id)
never: significant, robust, confirmed, accounts for dependence, no seasonal effect, tighter/more precise under blocks
